title: User Manual page · Targeting attack
items: New page: User Manual (Pack, Revise#427), opened from the Home page with the “User Manual” bar under “How to use”. Ten chapters: how to use the manual, the site at a glance, Card List, Deck Builder, Import / Export / Print Preview, Account, Game Table, reporting a problem, questions and answers, glossary.
English and Thai, switched with the buttons at the top right; “Back to the site” returns to the Home page.
The manual is made by the build (tools/manual/), so its version line follows the site's version.

Game Table (AQ-022, Revise#428): a character that may attack characters (A3-25 3686 and others) now has one menu line, “Targeting attack”. The characters it may attack turn blue, and a click on one declares the attack; Cancel leaves the choice. “Attack → player” is unchanged.

title: Print Preview: 1 mm between cards, whole pictures
items: Print Preview (Pack, Revise#426): the cards are now 1 mm apart on the page. Each card has its own cut outline, with marks in the margins.
The card picture is no longer cropped: the whole picture is fitted inside the 59 × 86 mm box. A picture with other proportions leaves a thin white strip on two sides.
The Landscape layout is removed (Pack). Pages are A4 portrait, 9 cards a page, margins 15.5 / 18.5 mm.

title: Print Preview: for logged-in players only
items: Export → Print Preview now needs a login (Pack, Revise#425). A visitor who is not logged in sees a short notice with a Log in button instead of the card list; the deck is not touched.
After logging in, open Export again and Print Preview works as before. Image (.jpg) and List (text) stay open to everyone.
This is a lock in the page itself: it keeps ordinary visitors out, but it is not a server-side protection.

title: Print Preview: cards at real size on A4
items: Deck Builder → Export → Print Preview (Pack, Revise#424): choose the cards of the deck to print. Each chosen card is laid out as many times as it is in the deck, at 59 × 86 mm, on A4 pages with cut lines.

Two layouts: Portrait, 9 cards a page (margins 16.5 / 19.5 mm — safe on any printer), or Landscape, 10 cards a page (margins 1 / 19 mm — only for printers that print to the edge). A picture that lies on its side is turned to fit.
Download as one .pdf (A4 pages) or as .png pages (2480 × 3508 px at 300 dpi, with the print size written in the file). 200 dpi makes smaller files. Print at 100% / “Actual size”, not “Fit to page”.

title: Simplified cards are “partly” again

The count is now 8,029 of 8,283 automatic (254 left: 146 by hand, 108 partly).

A4-04 0609 (Pack's ruling): its ±0/+10/−5 is worked out when the damage is dealt. Attack +10 counts for the damage check and the battle; Defense −5 and the opponent's −5/−5/−5 count in the battle only — as built in v5.65.

title: Bot: at most 2 characters waiting in the Active Area
items: Bot (Pack, Revise#410): it no longer sets a Character card while 2 or more of its characters are already in the Active Area. It charges those first. This also holds on its first turn, so it now sets 2 there, not 3. New parameter: activeMax (2).

title: Attacks on characters: guard or not · 3 reported cards · new and old reports
items: Rule (Pack, AQ-021 — ツイン・エンジェル“ファイラ”&“クリオラ” A3-25 3686 and every card that lets a character attack characters): when a character of another player is attacked, that player chooses whether the attacked character guards. Guard: a battle as usual. No guard: the damage is dealt to it as damage outside a battle. No other character may guard in its place.

各務流退魔拳法宗家“各務 柊子” (A3-24 3429, AQ-018): with a 各務 柊子 card below it, it now gains Bind 1 and takes no damage from normal attacks. “A card named X below this card” now also looks at the Name of the cards below, not only their full title.
ディスペル (A3-25 3700, AQ-020): now automatic. Its cost is ignored when its target was declared on one of your Project or Fast cards.
虹のバンダナ (A3-25 3619, AQ-019): Resist was tested in a battle and works there; the reported problem could not be repeated yet — the ticket stays open.
AQ-006 is done: Pack confirmed it works normally.

Admin → Card reports: every report now shows its ticket ([AQ-018 · done]) or [NEW]. New buttons: “Tick new” (reports with no ticket yet) and “Tick handled”, so only the new ones are copied or downloaded, and the handled ones are easy to delete.

title: Bug report AQ-016 closed
items: Bug reports: AQ-016 (ピュア・サイキッカー“斎木 新名”, A3-12 1763) is closed as not a bug — the card below it was the Saga 4 card A4-PP PP187, not the Saga 3 サイキック女子高生“斎木 新名”. Tickets can now show “Closed · not a bug”.

title: Search cards: just − N +
items: Deck Builder → Search cards (Pack, Revise#404): the five category buttons (Char / Break / Fast / Proj / Perm) are gone. Every card shows − N +; + adds the card under its own card type. A card with no card type goes to the category you last used for it, else Character — it can be moved from its details.

title: Control Area (Front) is one area again
items: Game Table (Pack, Revise#403): Control Area (Front) is no longer split into left / centre / right. It is one row, like Control Area (Back); its Sort button sorts the whole row.

AQ-006 (paying the attack or guard cost from another character, e.g. A3-12 1833): tested with a character that has no power cards — it can attack and guard, and the cost is paid from the other character. The problem could not be repeated on this version; a test now keeps this case working.

title: Three reported cards now automatic
items: 不動金縛りの法 (A3-25 3660, AQ-017): now automatic. You choose the target first; the cost is ignored when the target has no Name or its Attack is X or less (X = your Arayashiki Factor total).
皇帝の仮面 (A3-11 1711, AQ-012): now automatic. While it is set, every character's effects cost X more (X = the power cards on the character holding it).

命の蝋燭 (A3-22 3203, AQ-014): now automatic. In your Damage Pile, when your deck reaches 0 cards and you meet its Factor, you choose X characters to discard (X = the cards in your Damage Pile), then the card is discarded.
Bug reports: AQ-012, AQ-014 and AQ-017 are done. Still open: AQ-006 (カサンドラ・ソーン) and AQ-016 (斎木 新名).

title: Bug reports list brought up to date
items: Changelog → Bug reports (Pack): the 13 card reports received after AQ-004 are now tickets AQ-005 to AQ-017 — 8 done (fixed in v5.28, v5.40 and v5.45) and 5 open: カサンドラ・ソーン (A3-PR PR254), 皇帝の仮面 (A3-11 1711), 命の蝋燭 (A3-22 3203), 斎木 新名 (A3-12 1763), 不動金縛りの法 (A3-25 3660).

title: Card pictures from the new pictures site
items: Card pictures now come from the site's own pictures site (aqa-img.pages.dev, Cloudflare) instead of Google Drive: they load faster and the browser keeps them, so a second visit loads almost nothing. A picture that is missing there is still taken from Google Drive.

title: Ready for a faster pictures site
items: Card pictures (Pack, Revise#398): the site can now take card pictures from its own pictures site (Cloudflare Pages) instead of Google Drive. The address goes in assets/img-config.js. While it is empty nothing changes: pictures come from Google Drive as before.

When the pictures site is set, a picture that is missing there is taken from Google Drive by itself, so new cards show before the pictures site is updated. The deck image export uses the pictures site too.

title: 50 deck slots: 5 pages of 10
items: Deck Builder (Pack, Revise#397): 50 deck slots instead of 10, shown as 5 pages of 10. A new “Page” box sits beside the slot box; it also shows how many decks each page holds. Changing the page opens the slot at the same place on that page (slot 3 → slot 13 → slot 23 …). Your 10 decks stay where they are, on page 1.

Account: all 50 slots are kept in your account. Automatic saving now sends only the slots that changed, so it stays quick. The Save / Load page has page buttons 1–5 for both sides, and its confirmation lists only the slots that hold a deck.
Game Table, Solo, Campaign, Campaign Design, Basic Decks, Export / Import (“# Slot: N”): all know slots 1–50. Slot lists are grouped by page; on pages 2–5 only slots with a deck are listed.

title: Bot no longer gets stuck · 5 reported cards · the bot builds like the players
items: Bug fix (Pack's two replays, Revise#394): the bot declared 覚醒の乙女“藤宮 真由美”, found nothing it could set it on, cancelled, and declared it again — for ever. It no longer declares a card when the only thing left would be to cancel; and after three cancels in a row it moves on.

Card reports (Revise#395), now automatic: ブラッドシール (A4-05 0950 — “your Partner” is read as “this Name-level character”: Bind 2 and Charge X), 宝剣・草薙剣 (A3-23 3357), グレイプニル (A3-25 3691), サポートシグナル (A3-11 1743), 明王結界 (A3-17 2345).

Still not automatic from the reports: 不動金縛りの法 (A3-25 3660), 命の蝋燭 (A3-22 3203), 皇帝の仮面 (A3-11 1711). ピュア・サイキッカー“斎木 新名” (A3-12 1763): Infinity is given in every test with サイキック女子高生 below it — the report could not be repeated yet.

Bot (Pack, Revise#396): its building rules now come from how the players play (35 saved games, 274 player turns): 3 Character cards on its first turn and up to 2 on a later turn, only what it can charge this turn, Aggressive first; no attack before its 4th turn; one Character card is kept in the hand only while its Draw is under 2. New parameters: setFirstTurn, setPerTurn, reserveUntilDraw, attackTurnMin. New tool: tools/bot_habits.js.

title: Signed in: the account's decks replace the device's
items: Account (Pack, Revise#393): when you sign in, the decks on the device are replaced by the decks of your account — no merge step any more. Every deck you make or change is saved to the account by itself.
One exception so that nothing is lost: an account that has never held a deck takes the device's decks instead of emptying them.

title: Bot: it charges with every kind of card, one character at a time
items: Bug fix (Pack's replay, Revise#392): the bot kept every named Break card and every card of a Campaign playstyle in its hand, so with its reserved character it could charge nothing and its Active Characters stayed at 0 power. Now it keeps only the one Character card for next turn and the one Break card it plans to set; one copy of each other key card is used last; every other card — Break, Project, Fast, Permanent, and every second copy — is a power card.
The bot brings one character to the Control Area at a time: the power cards go to the character closest to its Mental, not to the Aggressive character that is there to attack.
It sets the Aggressive character first and the character for the Control Area after it.

title: Bot: a character kept for the next turn
items: Common bot (Pack, Revise#391): it no longer charges every Character card away. One Character card of its hand is kept for setting next turn — a Draw character while its Draw is under 2, a Charge character while its Charge is under 2, then the Main Factor.
On its first turn the bot sets one more Aggressive character (two in all).

title: Your decks belong to your account
items: Account (Pack, Revise#390): while you are logged in, the Deck Builder's 10 slots are your account's decks. Every change is saved to the account by itself, and the account's decks are loaded when you open the site — the same decks on every device you log in on.

If the decks on a device and in the account are different when you log in (a first login on a device that already has decks, or both were changed), nothing is copied: the Account page shows a notice, you bring the decks together with Save / Load as before, then choose “Use the account's decks” or “Use this device's decks”.
A first login on a device without decks simply loads the account's decks.

title: Card reports: 覚醒の乙女, Invisible Mantle
items: Bug fix (report, Revise#389): 覚醒の乙女“藤宮 真由美” (A3-25 3809) counted the abilities of the Mayumi cards below it twice — with two copies of サイキック・プライマル and 2 power cards she had +4/+4. Now +2/+2. The same double count is gone for every card that gains abilities from the cards below it.

Bug fix (report, Revise#389): インビジブルマント (A3-03 0514) went back to the hand when the attack was declared, so its Stealth was gone before the guard and any faction could guard. It now goes back when the attack was not guarded and is on the player.
Report on 武田 信玄 (Bind 2 + Bind 1 = Bind 3): already fixed in v5.28.

title: Bot rules for Draw / Charge, guarding and break cost; Hard decks: Dina and E.G.O. Mayumi
items: Common bot (Pack, Revise#385): when it chooses a Character card to bring to the Control Area, a character with Draw or Charge goes before one without a skill; among equals, a character of the deck's Main Factor goes first. A card without a skill waits in the hand while a better one could be set.

Common bot (Pack, Revise#386): while it has not enough Charge or Draw (Charge under 3, or Draw under 2), it does not guard an attack on itself with a character the attacker would defeat — the damage goes to the player. It still guards when the guard survives, or when the hit would end the game.

Common bot (Pack, Revise#387): a Break card with a cost is set on a character whose break cost returns to the hand (“このキャラクターをブレイクする場合、≪そのブレイクカードのコスト≫は手札に戻る”) when it has one that can take it. A Name-level Break card whose Name is already on its field goes on that character instead.

Campaign (Pack, Revise#388): new deck in Hard — Dina · Witch of the White Heavens, with a bot made for it: no attack before Selen Elsie is set; Dina herself attacks only when nobody can guard; Grimoire Servant is the first Break card; the Dina cards are stacked on one character; Grand Cross only with Dina out and two or more opposing characters without Shield; Pascha only when the power left pays a Break card. E.G.O. Mayumi moved to Hard. Hard can now be chosen.

title: Playstyle: Supportive Leader
items: New strategy in Campaign Design (Pack, Revise#384): Supportive Leader — the Name-level Break cards support by their effects and abilities. The bot sets every Main Supporter first and makes no attack before that; then it attacks once it has Charge more than 3 and Draw more than 2. A Main Supporter itself attacks only when it is sure to survive. Below the Critical number these conditions are off.

title: Campaign Design page · the deck E.G.O. Mayumi
items: Campaign Design is now its own page (Pack, Revise#382): Game Table → Campaign → Campaign Design, or table.html#campaigndesign. The imported deck is shown as on the Deck Builder page — columns of card pictures with × n. The Playstyle is a sidebar on the right that folds away.

Main Break, Main Attacker / Supporter / Disabler and the Special Priority cards are chosen in a pop-up of the same deck picture: click the cards, then press Apply. The Permanent card of each entry is chosen as before.

New Campaign deck (Pack's proposal, Revise#383): E.G.O. Mayumi — Hero Frontal Attack. Only Mayumi attacks, and only when she stays alive; her Break cards are stacked on her and 覚醒の乙女 stays on top. With fewer than 15 deck cards the bot attacks by the common rules. It is in Easy: this bot won 5 of 14 test games (the common bot with the same deck: 10 of 14).

title: Bot: what a Break card without a Name is for
items: Common bot (Pack, Revise#381): a Break card without a Name is used for a purpose. One that gives Charge or Draw goes on a character in the Active Area only. On a Controlled Character of another faction it is set only when the Factor is really needed — a card in the bot's hand asks for more of that faction than it controls. If there is no such place, the card stays in the hand.

title: Auto Re-shuffle keeps a Main Factor character
items: Auto Re-shuffle (Pack, Revise#380) now also wants at least one Character of the deck's Main Factor in the hand — the faction that the Factors of the deck's Name-level cards ask for most. The opening-hand line shows it: Main Factor (E.G.O.) 1/1. The bot's opening hand follows the same check. Games started before this version replay as they were.

title: Campaign Mode (Beta)
items: Campaign Mode (Pack, Revise#379), on the Game Table under Solo: choose your deck and a difficulty — Easy, Medium, Hard, Hell — and play a bot deck of that difficulty. Random Opponent picks one for you; untick it to choose the opponent. Hard and Hell have no deck yet. A coin toss decides who goes first.

The first Campaign decks are the bot's 8 training decks. Easy: the common bot wins under 70% with the deck (Astarte, Dina, Iaris, Seraphiel, ブレイブ, Cyborg Rider, Faris - Kuro). Medium: 70% or more (Mayumi).

Campaign Design, at the bottom of the Campaign box: import one deck from a Deck Builder slot and describe how its bot should play — Strategy (the common bot, or Hero Frontal Attack), Main Factor, Main Break, Main Attacker / Supporter / Disabler (with a description, a Permanent card and “Wait for permanent?”), Special Priority Condition, Critical number. Send it to the admin, or export the file.
Admin page: Campaign Bot Management — Active decks (move a deck to another difficulty) and Pending proposals (copy or export for Claude, delete).
Replay moved under Online.

title: Bot: the Charge limit is off
items: Bot (Revise#378): the Charge limit for attacking (attackChargeMin) is set to 0. The bot's own Charge total stays near 1.5 with several decks (Iaris, Cyborg Rider), so the limit of 3 stopped those decks from attacking at all — under one attack per game. The power limit (3 power cards) and the no-suicide rule stay.

Deck analysis: with the same deck on both sides, the new rules against the old attack style won 25 of 44 decided games (before this change: 40 of 75; Astarte and Faris lost clearly because of the Charge limit).

title: Bot: attack limits from the players' games
items: Bot (Pack, Revise#376): the attack limits now come from what players did in the saved games — 71 attacks by players. A quarter of them came with 3 or fewer power cards on the field (median 4), and 67 of 71 with Charge 3 or more (median 6). So: no attack below 3 power cards, and (new, attackChargeMin) no attack below Charge 3.
An attacker with Offensive is not held back by these two limits — the players' Offensive attackers survived 24 of 25 attacks.
New tool tools/bot_stats.js prints these numbers from a rooms file.

Bot, “the cost of this effect goes back to the owner’s hand” (Pack, Revise#377): on your turn it uses this only when the Game Situation is Conflict or Engage, not in Build or Interfere. Before using it, it sets aside the power it needs by its next turn — the cost of the card it takes back plus the cost of the best named Break card in its hand — and only takes the card when the power left covers that.

Bot bug fix (Revise#377): the bot read “is the Factor met?” the wrong way round in two places — it valued the hand cards it could NOT use more, and took a power card back only when it could not use it. Both are corrected.

title: Bot: fewer characters, no suicide attacks
items: Bot, Character cards (Pack, Revise#375): one Aggressive (▼) character is enough — the one with the highest Attack in its hand. Besides it, only one character at a time goes to the Active Area, and only when the bot can charge it fully this turn. Characters of the deck's Main Factor (the faction its Name-level cards ask for most) go first. A Break card with nothing to break may overrule this.

Bot, attacks (Pack, Revise#375): it charges first — no attack while its Controlled Characters hold fewer than 3 power cards (a hit that can win is always allowed). An attacker that a guard would defeat stays home, unless the strike wins even through every guard. It no longer attacks a character that would defeat it and survive.
New bot parameters: attackPowerMin (X), attackStrike, attackLoss, setActiveMax.

title: Who goes first
items: Bug fix (Pack, Revise#374): in Solo with two decks and against the Bot, "Who goes first" now decides the turn order — Deck 1 (you) or Deck 2 (the Bot). Before, a coin toss decided and the switch did nothing.

title: Hand card size
items: The hand has its own card size (Pack, Revise#373): a slider at the right end of the hand — S 0.5×, M 0.8×, L 1× — the same as Control · Back. The choice is remembered.

title: Bind X given more than once
items: Bug fix (Pack, Revise#372): several Bind X on one character are no longer added up. With Bind 1 and Bind 3 the character pays 1 or 3 power cards (you choose), never 4. The status line shows "Bind 1 / 3".

title: Hand: one height, fixed position
items: The hand no longer moves up and down (Pack, Revise#371): an empty hand keeps the room of one card, the scroll bar always has its place, and the title line stays on one line.
Fixed hand position: the 📌 button beside Expand puts the hand in a bar at the bottom of the field, as wide as the field. Click it again to let the hand float.

title: Cards: 1 more
items: Card (Revise#370): 強者の戦い (EX0485) — named characters get +1/+1 in battle for each power card of the battle opponent.

title: Cards: 5 more
items: Card batch (Revise#369): every player names a character of the work and takes a card with that name, or with the name in its text, from the deck (EX0480, EX0498); a card in the Damage Pile set on 東條 莉亜 (EP372); EX912, EP423.

items: Card batch (Revise#368): power cards for the damage an opponent's card deals (EX865); damage to the side of a character killed in battle (0342); a Break card set from the Damage Pile after a damage check (3799); EX0058, EX0292, EP440, 0785, 0787, 2358.

items: Card batch (Revise#367): the cost of a 武蔵 / 英国 / 三征西班牙 Break card comes back and the card is discarded (EX874, EX875, EX876); one Project card at fast timing in each turn, and a lasting bonus for a named character (0876, 0894); EX910, EX911, EP378, 3125.

items: Card batch (Revise#366): Factor (and cost) down by cards from the top of your deck (EX0472, 2031, PP277); every player swaps the Damage Pile for cards of the Discard Pile (0445); “マルガ・ナルゼ” and “マルゴット・ナイト” fighting together (EX802, EX803, EX0669, EX0672); EX0595.

title: Cards: 9 more

title: Sort hand · card size on the field
items: Pack: Sort hand — a button beside the hand's fold button (the same icon as the Control Area sort): by faction (the common order), then Mental low → high, cost low → high, Factor low → high, then Character · Break · Permanent · Fast · Project. It can be undone (Revise#336).

title: Solo games really saved · stronger bot
items: Fix (Pack: “the Solo log does not show in my admin page”): a finished Solo game was sent to the game log in a way the database rules refuse, without any message. It is now added entry by entry like an online room, and a message shows if saving fails (Revise#333).
Bot: 90 minutes of training on 13 decks (the basic ones and Pack's own): the new bot won 38 of 58 games against the v4.91 bot (Revise#334).

title: Bot: sets characters and attacks only when it helps
items: Pack's feedback: the bot no longer puts every Character card into the Active Area. It sets one only when it can be brought into the Control Area with the power cards it can give this turn and the next, or when it is Aggressive (▼, its attack on its owner brings characters from the deck). The others stay in the hand as power cards (Revise#330).

Pack's feedback: the bot waits for a suitable moment to attack a player — when no untapped character there that can pay its guard would defeat the attacker, when it is ready for the finishing strike, or when the hit wins (Revise#331).

Pack: the bot reads its deck's Break cards with a Name before it plays and gives each a job — attacker, supporter, defender. With one in the hand it keeps enough power cards on the field for its cost, does not spend it as a power card while another card can be, breaks the attacker first while it is still building, and a supporter does not attack before the finishing strike. Bot vs Bot: hover the plan text to see each bot's named cards (Revise#332).
Fix: the bot no longer repeats a declaration that cancels itself (no valid target).

title: Bot: more of your style · new Solo box
items: Pack: the bot learned from 3 of Pack's games (196 of his choices): it now makes the same choice as Pack in 96 of them (69 before), and it won 25 of 40 games against the v4.89 bot (Revise#327).

Pack: the Solo box follows Pack's design — Deck 1, Deck 2, a “Who goes first” switch (Deck 1 / Deck 2), then “Play by yourself” (Player · Player #1 vs Player #2) and “Play with the bot” (Player vs Bot · Bot vs Bot) side by side (Revise#328).

Pack: the Changelog page has two tabs — Changes and Bug reports. Bug reports shows each card report as a ticket: what was reported, how it was broken down, the cause, the fix, how it was checked, and captures before and after (Revise#329).

title: Response Timing, Auto Re-shuffle, skill values, movable event screens
items: “Respond Together” is now “Response Timing”: 1: By Sequence / 2: Anytime Interrupts (Revise#233).
New “?” explanations for Response Timing, Game Situation, Auto-Skip and Auto-Pay (Revise#233).
Opening hand: “Auto Re-shuffle” — up to 10 re-shuffles until the hand has 3 Characters, Draw, and Charge with an effect whose cost returns to the hand (Revise#234).
Skills show their value with a sign: “Permanent +1”, “Charge -1” (Revise#235).
Every event screen can be dragged by its title and folded with ▾ / ▸ (Revise#236).
Card details → Status: the source of each change is shown as the card’s picture; click it for its details (Revise#237).
Fix: normal and mental Attack are worked out separately, each at least 0 — A3-08 1247’s “-X・+(X)” / “+X・-(X)” now work (Revise#238).
Fix: a character over its Permanent limit (e.g. when A3-11 1660’s Permanent +1 ends) is dealt with at once (Revise#239).
Lobby: Auto-pick sits beside the “Player image” title (Revise#240).
The other players' piles are back on the right; from the top Player · Discard · Deck · Damage (Revise#241).

title: Wide-scale card abilities in Field effects; cards: Ragnarok Online, Gunbuster, Super Sonico
items: Fix: A3-11 1660 sets every chosen Permanent, one by one — the card shown big with its details, the character clicked on the field; its Permanent +1 now works (Revise#231).
The Player options / Game options buttons no longer show a summary (Revise#232).
Field effects lists the always-on abilities of cards on the field that reach players, every card of a kind or every matching character — e.g. “Darklore Project cost + 1” (Revise#230).
Cards: A4-EP EP466 / EP482 / EP485 / EP494 / EP495 / EP515 / EP518 / EP522 / EP525 / EP528 / EP541 / EP545 / EP554 / EP555 / EP590 / EP601 / EP603 are automatic (Revise#229).
New works for series rules: Ragnarok Online, Super Sonico (Revise#229).

title: Defaults ON, Current column, one Player options page, deck name at Finish, ▲ / ▼ counts
items: Respond Together, Game Situation and Global Undo/Redo are ON by default; Game Status pop-up waits 60 s (Revise#225).
Game options → Skip: a “Current” column you can click row by row; click a situation header to declare it (Revise#225).
Player options is one page (Options, then Card size); Hold moved to Game options when Game Situation is OFF (Revise#225).
Deck Builder: Template Finish asks for the deck name — the name-level card with the most copies is suggested (Revise#226).
Deck Builder: ▲ / ▼ beside each card count on the deck board (Revise#226).
The other players' Deck, Discard and Damage piles are on the opposite side, as seen from across the table (Revise#227).
Cards: A3-02 0388, A4-EP EP403 / EP425 / EP436 / EP437 are automatic (Revise#228).

title: Status table, effect text in Resolve, Charge window in the hand, turn-end fix
items: Card details: Status as a table — one row per card that changes it, a Skill column, the older text in a “?” (Revise#224).
Resolve shows an Effect's text; the Charge window is inside the hand at the bottom (drag the hand by its title) and lists the cards already charged (face up when you may see them) (Revise#224).
Fix: “ターン終了時に…” abilities (A3-20 2835) were skipped when a choice was asked right after the turn ended (Revise#224).

title: More automatic cards
items: Phase box at the top of the panel: 5 pastel blues in your turn, pastel red / orange / pink in an opponent's turn (Revise#223).
Log: “!” in front of every By hand line (Revise#223).
EX0295, EX0297, EX0290, 1256, 2579, EP342, EP198 and more; Main Phase / turn start triggers written “…開始時に、” now work (Revise#222).

title: A3-16 2175 and A3-22 3128
items: A3-16 2175 (Brave Kaiser from the hand with every “ブレイブ” Permanent) and A3-22 3128 (a マシン Break card from your piles, mill X, a power card when it is set) run by themselves (Revise#221).

title: Import Empty Check, Auto-pick Player image, A4-01 0116 Penetrate, 10 more automatic cards
items: Template: every printing of a card name has its own tile; A3-11 1742 and A3-22 3311 run by themselves (Revise#220).
Deck Builder Import: “Empty Check” asks “Would you like to overwrite slot number 1, 7 and 10?” (Yes / No) before replacing slots that have cards (Revise#219).
Player image: “Auto-pick” is first and the default — the picture of the faction with the most name-level Break cards in your deck (Revise#218).
A4-01 0116: Penetrate while the character's Attack is 10 or more — Pack's Kiriko battle now sends 15 − 7 = 8 to the player (Revise#218).

Watchers on the target's battles, Attack −1 for both sides, “lost a character in battle this turn”, Protect from the Damage Piles and more — 1918, EX0185, EX0594, EX0600, EX0602, EP387, EP202, EXPR035, EX0467, EX0468 (Revise#217).

title: More automatic cards
items: Watchers on the target's battle damage and attack, “one of two skills” choice, targets from either pile, open hands for a while — EX0605, EX0613, EX0325, EX0474, EX0150 and more (Revise#216).

title: The Player on the field, Player image, User → Target
items: The Player sits at the bottom right of each field (the size of the Deck): its picture, skills and the effects on that player; click it for details, or to choose the player as a target (Revise#214).
Player image: 6 default pictures or your own upload (PC, iPhone / iPad, Android), above Game rules; the Game table explanation is in a “?” (Revise#214).
Resolve: a character's effect shows User → Target (the target's card, or the target player's picture) (Revise#214).
A3-18 2466 runs by itself; a skill given to a player (Charge 5) now counts (Revise#214).
More automatic cards: A3-11 1688 / 1658, PP271, PP090, EX0059, EP390, EP386, EX0342 (Revise#215).

title: Search asked every time, Skip table in Game options, Deck Builder without card limits, 20 more automatic cards
items: Search: a Search card in your hand is asked at the start of every Main Phase; A3-25 3723 takes 1 card instead of the whole draw (or draws as usual); cards chosen from a deck are always face up for the chooser (Revise#213).
Game Situation: Build now skips Effect too (Pack's table); a “Skip” table in Game options right before Outlaw when Game Situation is ON; every Game options explanation is in a “?” (Revise#212).
Deck Builder: no card limit — no 60-card cap and no 4-copies-per-name cap; 50–60 is shown as a guide only (Revise#211).
Choose 1 skill to negate, “milled from the deck → back to hand”, Permanents for one named character (both sentences), battle with a Controlled Character → back to hand (Revise#210).

Cost less per different faction, reveal a card to ignore the factor, targets chosen from the card being declared, Capacity ± discard / draw, “pay the cost from one character”, “can't attack you” and more (Revise#209).

title: 9 more automatic cards, cost window size, deck badges
items: Cost window card size S / M / L; Charge / Draw badges at the top inside the deck.
持続 cards keep a no-duration change while they stay; “Active Phase only”, “no card used this turn”, “target is 「card name」”, “paid only from …” and more (Revise#208).

title: 13 more automatic cards, Game Situation row, Resolve button
items: Initiative: a character kept by Bind (or any keep) still strikes back after the first strike.
Hold: Fast and Effect are separate switches.
Battle box: defender info from the top, “vs” on a yellow line; a skill given twice shows twice.
Game Situation sits under the option buttons; Attack / Guard and Fast / Effect are never skipped by a situation now.
The last pass a declaration waits for is a green “Resolve” button.
Choosing a target shows the card being declared.
Peek at your top card, each player returns a power card, ▼ draw / discard, “cost only from …”, Permanents that work only on their character with an ability, and more.

title: About 30 more automatic cards
items: Solo (one deck) follows Hold / Game Situation; Game Situation is one coloured row (Build · Interfere · Conflict · Engage) at the top of Game options.
Control · Back has its own card size (S / M / L); the Size bar sits at the top right of your field.
Sort: by type first (every Draw character leftmost), then faction. Undo / Redo skip option changes.
Cost window keeps its scroll; “Attack +2” on a (1) character shows 2 (1); Game options “Flip down all power cards”; card details show one row per source.
Deck searches show the cards face up; the battle in Resolve shows each card with Name · Skill · Status beside it, battle skills highlighted.
Bind must be paid to survive mental damage; A3-19 2650 returns the Damage Pile card; Resolve shows steps for every declaration; the log has a colour per kind and “!” on warnings.
Game options: the Game Status box after 30 / 60 / 120 / 180 s.
Hold starts at a new default (Aggressive and Break / Permanent OFF) with a Default button. All ON / All OFF include Undo. Each switch explains itself under a “?”.
Options tab in three groups (Phase · Cost · Gameplay); Game Situation help under a “?”.
The head of each field shows every phase (the current one bright) and Fast / Project Timing.
Player options / Game options side bars close when you click outside them.
Designated characters chosen when a card is declared, name-level duels, swapping a Permanent with one from the hand, “free / no factor when …” for Project and Fast cards, N+X damage, and more.

title: About 50 more automatic cards
items: Game table lobby: the game rules are big ON / OFF boxes above Solo / Online, each with a “?” explanation.
Next card without its factor, attack tax towards a player, Capacity −X, attack from a discarded character, called-off battles, and more.
“…場合、代わりに、…” lines, and “if this card's cost was paid only from “X””.
Name lists (“A”、“B”、“C”), cards that keep working after the turn ends, the works of the Extra Packs, and more Permanent abilities that only work on a named character.

title: 9 more automatic cards
items: Card-name groups (「冒険者」), “if a broken “X” is in your area” damage, end-the-turn Project cards, battle-opponent skill negation, a Break card from the Damage Pile when the target attacks.
Deck Builder templates: Setup starts with the main icon and main factor most common on your Main Break cards, sub icon None, sub factor Any.
Deck Builder templates: click a card picture (ⓘ) to open its details over the template; closing goes back to the template.
Resolve list: each label (Card, Cost → hand …) on its own row, its cards on the row below.
Charge X: A3-19 2656 gets its Charge X; the board shows skill values (“Charge 6”).
Card details: an “X” box — X = N now, and the characters / cards it counts.

title: About 40 more automatic cards (Saga 3 specials)
items: Permanents made for one character, “if the target is “X””, Lyrical Nanoha series selectors and cost-backs, deck searches, and more.

title: Lethal Damage warning; coloured card menu and battle steps
items: When an opponent's attack on you has Attack + your Draw ≥ your Deck, a small red “⚠ Lethal Damage” pop-up shows for 1 s, then fades. It never blocks a click.
Card menu: Effect pastel yellow, Attack pastel red, Guard pastel blue, Card details pastel green; an effect shows its whole line.
Resolve: the battle shows Attack › Guard › Response › Resolved in pastel red / blue / yellow / green.
Breakthrough given after an unbroken character guarded: the guard fails, no battle, the attacker's damage goes to the player.
A Permanent set at Fast timing waits in Resolve as a Fast card (Hold “Fast / Effect”).
⚑ Game options: Global Undo/Redo (any player may undo / redo any player's action), Game Situation and Outlaw.
Attack shows normal and mental apart: “44 (1)”. “+(N)” on Attack is mental Attack (Open-Finger Gloves and similar).

title: Field effects and log in the card's words; Hold “Aggressive”
items: Field effects: one row per effect — “Gain skill “Shield, Offensive, Defensive” to ≪all Dragoon and Dragoon♂ characters you control≫”.
Log: “Card” uses Effect “1: …” with the card's English text, instead of one “Effect:” line per change.
Hold: a new “Aggressive” switch for the ▼ attacks of the Active Phase, above “Attack / Guard” (now Main Phase battles only).
A Permanent card can be set only on a character with a free Permanent slot (one Permanent per character, more with Permanent +X).

title: Special Area beside the Active Area; 5 more automatic cards
items: The Special Area is now at the right end of the Active Area row.
Different-name / different-faction searches from the deck, and Keep choices paid from a deck (3510, 3543).

title: 10 more automatic cards
items: Base mental Attack from a Permanent, Attack / Guard Costs raised by each owner's hand, “paid only from the target”, four separate choices in one card, a Project that comes back to the hand when you don't draw, cost-X Permanents from the deck, and more.

title: Player options side bar
items: ⚙ Player options opens a side bar at the right: one tab for the card size and Hold (or the Game Situation), one tab for the other options.
Log: “Save replay” sits at the right of the Log header; the Replay and Export .txt buttons are gone.

title: 8 more automatic cards
items: Power cards back to the decks, same-class Break searches, name-or-text returns from the Damage Pile, a Permanent that cancels the declarations aimed at its character, and more.

title: 7 more automatic cards
items: Abilities when you break a character with a named Break card of a faction, Permanents from the damage check onto your character, Ghost characters from the hand at the end of the Main Phase, Permanents protected from the Damage Pile.

title: About 10 more automatic cards
items: Hand-limit trims, power cards back to the hand when a character leaves, faction power returns, “end your Main Phase”, multi-attacks for a turn, and more.

title: Cards that become characters
items: Project cards that set themselves as a character (護法童子, 前鬼 / 後鬼, 式神阿式) and hand cards set as ミラーパネル now run by themselves.

title: About 12 more automatic cards
items: Pay an Attack / Guard Cost with the top 2 cards of your Deck (button in the pay window), Permanents immune to effects, discounts per faction, battle-start power discards, and more.

title: Discount by hand cards · about 17 more automatic cards
items: Cards whose factor and cost go down for each hand card discarded when declared: you choose the hand cards first.
More automatic cards: conditional Fast timing, chosen X, damage cut, guard without cost, Break with a class anywhere, and more.

title: About 10 more automatic cards
items: A chosen stat (Mental / Attack / Defense), “discard one of its cards to keep it”, keeping a character against opponents' effects, attacking a class, and more.

title: About 24 more automatic cards
items: Permanent / Project / Fast / Break cards of A3-07 … A3-25: Permanents that pay their character's Attack Cost, “discard this card to keep the target”, cards that go back to the hand when removed, one character of each faction, no opponent Break, and more.

title: Game Table: Game Situation — one shared Hold for the whole table
items: Lobby → “Game Situation”: the room creator turns it on before creating the room.
Situations Building · Interfering · Conflicting · Engaging decide what everyone's Hold skips; anyone declares a new one, with a pop-up “[Player] declares [Situation]” for everyone.
Rest the cursor on a situation for 1 second to see what it skips. The Undo switch is in Player options.

title: Game Table: Hold by type · more automatic cards
items: Hold is split into types: Attack / Guard, Project, Fast / Effect, Break / Permanent — each ON or OFF for you; the newest declaration decides which one applies. A separate Undo switch decides whether other players' undos wait for you.
The Hold button opens the switches (All ON / All OFF) and shows ON, OFF or 3/4.
About 10 more Permanent / Project / Fast cards run by themselves (area damage, attack cancels after a guard, chosen classes, Mental ↔ Defense swap).

title: Deck Builder: red frame on cards the Game Table can't run by itself · more automatic cards
items: Deck Builder: cards that are not automatic in the Game Table yet have a red frame (deck board and Search cards); the summary shows how many are in the deck.
About 16 more Permanent / Project / Fast cards run by themselves: hand discards at the declaration, “if … , …” sentences, “対象は…”, cost bans and cost destinations for one character, and more.

title: M3b … M3f: about 27 more Permanent / Project / Fast cards run by themselves
items: Project / Fast cards that keep watching while they last: “if the target battles / deals damage, discard this card”, “characters that pay a cost are discarded”, “when a named Break card with this class is set, its owner …”.
When such a card is discarded, its lasting effect ends with it.

New pieces: “can't be kept on the field”, “gains every faction's factor X”, “each player draws as many as their Controlled Characters”, “discard 2 from your deck to return this card to your hand”, and more.

title: Optional abilities ask again · new mental damage rule · Fool text
items: Optional abilities (“…可能”) ask Run / Skip in a pop-up. Player options → “Run optional abilities without asking” runs them at once.
Mental damage: at most the power → that many power cards are discarded; more → none are discarded and the character is defeated, unless it has Bind.
Outlaw → “Fool text”: A3-23 joke cards play their フールテキスト; real-world instructions are shown in the log.
About 40 more Permanent / Project / Fast cards of A3-06 … A3-25 run by themselves.

title: M3b … M3f: about 130 more Permanent / Project / Fast cards run by themselves
items: Cards with modes: the hand menu offers each effect ("Card — effect 1: …"); the chosen one is played.
Cards usable as a Fast card with another factor ("W4のファストカードとして使用宣言可能").
Permanents that move to another character when theirs leaves, Permanents for a named character or a class, Damage Pile triggers, first-Break-of-the-turn triggers and more.

title: Game Table: abilities run at once, clearer Resolve screen, by-hand log highlight · Deck image columns
items: Abilities run at once: no Run / Skip question, not on the Resolve list. One that needs a target asks in a pop-up; click the target on the field.
Battles: after the attack and the guard, every player may answer or pass in any order.

Resolve screen: buttons at the top, newest first, keeps its scroll; shows the card played, cost cards going back to the hand, and the attacker / guard pictures with Status and Skills. "Last battle" removed.
Pop-ups: Undo Agree / Refuse, abilities and Changing Target (old target left, new targets right). Pay screen on the right side.
Project / Fast cards show on the character they target. Power cards: pastel yellow section; Permanents: pastel light blue.
Click a player's field header to look at their hand (cards open to you by effects such as A3-17 2325).
Log: lines done by hand have a pastel orange highlight; the .txt export marks them with ✋. Cost back to the hand by Offensive / Defensive / Infinity is shown face down.
Fix: A3-05 0722 looked at hands again when a Permanent was set on the character.
Fix: "all its skills are negated" (A3-20 2696 …) now also removes skills granted afterwards and the Initiative of the cards under it.
Deck Builder → Export → Image: the board's columns and order (Character · main factor / other, Break, Fast, Project, Permanent).
6 more Permanent / Project / Fast cards of A3-01 … A3-05 run by themselves.

title: M2g complete · English ability and target explanations
items: Saga 3 special sets: the last 27 Break cards now run by themselves — M2g is complete.
Cards used as a Fast card from the hand, forced battles and guards, token raids, damage-replacement prompts, Install Permanents and more.
Card List and Table card details: Abilities, Targets and Conditions are shown in English (Japanese as the tooltip).

title: Replay
items: Log → Replay: watch the game again from the start, 0.5× – 3× speed, step back / forward, jump with the slider, choose whose side to see.
Log → Save replay (.json) and Lobby → Open a replay file.
Replay log: the in-game log lines in their own window, up to the current step.

title: M3a: about 95 Permanent / Project / Fast cards of A3-01 … A3-05 run by themselves
items: Permanent, Project and Fast cards of A3-01 … A3-05: 95 of 130 cards that needed hands now run by themselves (35 left).
Permanent abilities work for the character they are set on; more turn-ending, cost-routing, declaration-ban and damage rules.

title: M2g: about 165 more special-set Break cards run by themselves
items: Saga 3 special sets (EP, EX01 – EX05, EXPP, EXPR, PP, PR, SIGN): 258 of 285 Break cards with rules text now run by themselves; 27 are left by hand for now (Q#63).
A3-PR personality promos (PR326 – PR329) play as the card they name.
New rules support: extra phases, once-per-turn effects, damage taken for another character or for you, negate the next damage, name-a-type guesses and more.

title: Export Log as .txt; ザラーム (Q#60); M2g: about 95 more special-set Break cards
items: Game Table: the Log has an Export .txt button — the whole log as a text file.
A3-25 3756 ザラーム runs by itself (Q#60): its extra turn blocks cards from hands and lets only Named characters with power ≥ its power pay costs. M2f is complete.
About 95 more Break cards of the Saga 3 special sets (EP, EX, PR, PP …) run by themselves.

title: Fix: 2385 ソフィー・ラスタバン gives +2/+2/+2 to the characters it makes Dragoon♂
items: A class given by an ability now counts for the bonuses that look at that class at once.

title: Deck Builder: 2 Character columns, search pop-up, automatic order; Game Table: Outlaw options, Pick from deck
items: Deck Builder: Character cards in two columns (main factor / other factors), Search opens as a pop-up like the Card List, and Character / Break cards are arranged automatically.
Game Table: Player options → Outlaw (Flip-up Discard Pile, Flip-up all Power Card), shown in red in the log.
Game Table: By hand → Pick card from deck (numbered from the top) to your hand, Damage Pile or Discard Pile.
Q#56 – Q#59 cards (3394, 3461, 3537, 3616) run by themselves.

title: Card size: a 6-level bar
items: The S / M / L buttons are now a slider with 6 levels: Lv 1 = the old S, Lv 4 = the old M, Lv 6 = the old L, the others in between.

title: M2e done; M2f: all but 5 cards (Q#56 – Q#60)
items: About 110 more A3-21 … A3-25 Break cards run by themselves (area damage, token Permanents, extra costs, draw changes, partner Break cards and more).
A3-02 0233, 0373 and 0390 run by themselves too.
5 cards wait for answers: 3394, 3461, 3537, 3616 (second half) and 3756.

title: Game Status, Pass All, the Kicking Tiger freeze fixed, M2e batches 5–6
items: Fix: after running a triggered ability with a target (e.g. Kicking Tiger), Pass did nothing — the game looked stuck. It resolves again.
Game Status: after 30 s with no action, a box shows what the game is waiting for, with Copy log (to send us) and Skip (moves the game one step on, logged, can be undone).
Pass All on the Resolve list: passes on every item now on it.
About 30 more A3-21 … A3-25 Break cards run by themselves (3759, 3116, 3688, 3121, 3228, 3646 and more).

title: Q#55 cards: A3-16 … A3-20 Break cards all automatic
items: 2199, 2253, 楊戩, 2279, ジリアン, フェンリル, 2418, 2721, 2865 and 2867 run by themselves.

title: Game Table (v4) on the main site
items: New tab 8. Game Table v4: the new table built on the v4 rules engine — Solo with one or two decks, Online rooms for 2–4 players, test rooms on this computer. It uses your Deck Builder slots.

Rules handled by the table: phases, declarations with pay → target → Resolve list, strict priority, battles with every skill, Keep / Let it go, triggered abilities, the Event System pop-ups and the field effects. Card text it can't read yet is shown as “✋ do by hand”.
