New page coverage.html (link in the table's lobby): which cards and which lines the new table runs by itself, with search and filters. More card text is read automatically now: about 1,080 effect lines and 2,218 of 2,521 Characters.

title: Phone layout for the table
items: Phones and narrow screens (≤ 900 px): the table is one column — the field uses the full width, then Field effects · Resolve box · controls (phase, Undo / Redo, Next) · log below it. Before, the control column sat beside the field and squeezed it to a thin strip.

Phones (≤ 600 px): rows are only as tall as their cards; Damage / Deck / Discard sit in one row under your areas (above the opponent's); empty faction slots are short; the Project / Fast box goes under the Control area (Front).
The hand panel is docked to the bottom edge of the screen, full width, and the cards scroll sideways (Fold hides it).

title: Break restrictions · character-or-player targets · Defense 0
items: Break restrictions written on the card are followed (about 500 cards): 【“ィアーリス”のみブレイク可能】 = only on a character with that name (e.g. A3-01 0200 only on a “ィアーリス”; the icon exception can't be used). Also 【分類に関わらず、ダークロアのキャラクターをブレイク可能】 (no shared icon needed for those), 【ブレイクしている“X”のみ…】, 【“X”が場に存在する場合のみ…】, 【あなたの / 他のプレイヤーのテリトリーのキャラクターのみ…】, パワー0, ▼, 支配キャラクター … A wrong target says the rule in a toast.
Targets ≪キャラクターまたはプレイヤー1人≫ (e.g. the effect A3-17 2400 gains): choose first — click a player's Deck (running blue border) to target that player, or a character on the field.
Target conditions are checked when choosing and again on resolution: ≪ブレイクしていないキャラクター≫ no longer accepts a character with a Break card (or a Break card itself); also faction, area, icons, ▼, パワー0 …

Defense ≤ 0 → defeated at once. If the character has Bind X or a “捨て札になる場合、…で場に残す” ability, it waits in the Resolve box (red outline) and its owner chooses Keep (pays Bind / the written cost) or Let it go; Next / End wait for that. When the 0 comes only from this battle, keeping it works (it stays until the battle ends). When the 0 lasts (e.g. until end of turn), the cost can be paid but it is defeated anyway. Damage and “discard” effects use the same save step.
New timing “バトル終了時まで” (until end of battle) for stat changes.
Play Online: Firebase project “aqage-online-play” is set up, so Create / Join room works between two computers.

Fix: Play Online showed “Could not open the room: undefined” right after creating a room — the room is now opened normally. Moves are sent as plain JSON (Firebase refuses empty values), and a real error now says what went wrong (e.g. the database rules).
Play Online: choose which of your 10 deck slots to play with (Deck select in the lobby, like Solo Test). The choice is remembered; empty slots can't be chosen.

title: Target a card in the Resolve box · Cast prevention
items: Effects that target a card being used (“使用した / 使用宣言中の … カード1枚”, e.g. A3-14 2058) open a pop-up listing the cards declared before it in the Resolve box (filtered by type and by whose: opponent's / yours). When the effect resolves, that card is taken out of the Resolve box without resolving and goes to its owner's hand, discard pile or deck as the text says (A3-10 1498 / 1506, A3-18 2480 / 2485, A3-22 3131, A3-EX EX0159 / EX0185, A4-EX EX905 …).

New field effect Cast prevention: “…この効果で手札に戻ったカードと同じ名称のカードを使用宣言することができない” records the returned card's name and which players are blocked, until end of main phase (or turn). It shows in the Field effects box as “Cast prevention: 「name」 – can't be declared by any player”; those cards in hand are no longer highlighted as playable and can't be declared. − ends it early.

Resolve box resolves one at a time: when everyone passes, only the latest declaration (top) resolves. The passes then reset, and everyone may respond again (Fast / effects) before the next one resolves.

title: Choose a faction
items: Effects for “≪あなたの任意の勢力1つの…全て≫” (e.g. A3-01 0206 “Discard all characters of any 1 faction of your choice”) first open a pop-up to choose the faction (with the number of characters of each), then the card is declared and, when it resolves, works on every character of that faction. Works the same for “勢力パーティ1つ” (that faction's party in the Active area). “あなたの任意の…” is now read as “…of your choice” everywhere (it reaches every player's characters unless the text says whose).

title: Event System (pick from discard / damage pile), template Charge order
items: Event System: texts like A3-23 3359 “このカードがセットされた場合、≪プレイヤー全て≫は自分の捨て札置き場のカード1枚を手札に加える” and A3-09 1318 (a Student card from the damage pile and one from the discard pile) now open a pop-up for each player when the card resolves — the same card list as the discard / damage pile; choose the card(s), then Select to put them into your hand. The damage pile comes first, then the discard pile, as the text says; a pile with no matching card is skipped. The other player sees “Waiting for … to choose” in the Resolve box; Next / End turn wait until everyone has chosen.
Triggered abilities that must happen and need no choice (like 3359's) now happen at once when the card resolves, instead of waiting for Run.
Deck Builder templates, Charge steps: inside each icon group the order is Charge 2 → Charge 1 with “1：cost returns to hand” → Charge 1 with Shield → with Bind → with Synchro → other Charge 1.

title: Character menu sections, piles together, cost before resolve
items: Clicking a character: the menu is split into coloured sections — Attack (pastel red), Defense (pastel blue: guard, battle with the attacker, damage), Effect (pastel yellow: card effects, Other effect with an adjustable number of power cards 1–6, stat changes, conditions) and Control (pastel green). Control has Defeated in battle (named Break cards → damage pile, the rest → discard pile), Defeated outside battle (everything → discard pile) and Card details. Move left / right / Front / Back were removed from the menu (drag the cards instead).
Damage / Deck / Discard sit together in one column at the right edge — at the bottom of your board, at the top of the opponent's.

Cost first: after paying a cost, the paid cards must be put somewhere (Cost window) before anything resolves or the battle goes on — the Resolve box says so and the Pass / Resolve button waits. When an effect itself says where its cost goes (“≪このエフェクトのコスト≫を手札に戻す”, “…をパワーカードとしてセット” …), that happens right away when it is declared.

title: Hold, hidden power cards, field effects in English, Cost return, Special
items: Field effects box: simpler — who it reaches as icon / faction / name (e.g. “Scholar / Scholar ♂”), then only the stats that change (“+ Attack 2 / − Defense 1”), in English (card abilities use the card's English text). Click an effect to highlight its source card (or, for effects you added, the characters it reaches) with a running pastel-orange border; click again to clear.
Play Online: power cards set from the hand are seen only by their owner by default (the opponent sees the card back). The game rule can still make them open to both players.
The opponent now sees the power cards you paid as a cost (face up, in the Resolve box) until you choose where they go.

Hold (control box, both players, any time): Hold ON — both players must agree (pass) before anything resolves or the battle goes on; when both players have Hold OFF, the turn player alone may resolve. Default: ON.

Cost returns to hand (new effect type): 110 always-on abilities like A3-25 3680 “≪スカラー・スカラー♂のネームを持つブレイクカードのコスト≫は手札に戻る” now send the cost straight back to the hand when a matching card is played — for every card on the field, cost paid from this character, Break / Permanent cards set on this character, or the card itself.

Special (new type, written for one wording): A3-24 3459 — when a Scholar in a Control area attacks a player or guards a dominated character's attack, its owner may draw 1 (Run / Skip in the Resolve box).
“このキャラクター以外の…全て” abilities now reach the other characters (they were read as this character only).

title: Attack more than once
items: A character can attack several times in one turn — each attack pays its attack cost again (one attack is resolved at a time). It can also guard after attacking. A ⚔ badge on the card shows how many times it attacked this turn (cleared at the start of its owner's next turn); cards are no longer turned sideways.
Control area (Back) now uses the same card size as the Front row and grows the same way (more cards wrap onto more lines; the three areas keep equal height).

title: Resolve Box: declarations and responses
items: The Battle box is now the Resolve Box. Break, Fast and Project cards and effects are first declared (cost paid, the card waits in the box) instead of working at once. Every player may respond with a Fast card or an effect (it goes on top) or press No response (pass). When everyone has passed with nothing new, everything resolves from the top: what was declared last takes effect first (A → B → C resolves C → B → A). A declaration whose target is gone is cancelled — the cost stays paid and the card is discarded. Solo Test: one Resolve click. Next / End turn wait until the box is empty; inside a battle, the battle goes on after the box is resolved.
Fast and Project cards now do their text when they resolve (targets are chosen when they are declared), using the Effect System — e.g. A3-03 0517 グランドクロス deals (1) damage to every character.
A character defeated in battle: its named Break cards (“name”) go to their owner's damage pile; the other cards go to the discard pile.

title: Conditions with effects, X values, damage-zone abilities
items: A3-24 3465: conditions that give other characters something first and then “≪このキャラクター≫はエフェクト「…」を持つ” are read too — the effect “1: target's Defense becomes 1” now appears when 「ディーナ・ウィザースプーン」 is under it. New effect type “set Mental / Attack / Defense to N”.

X: one “Xは…” line now defines X for every effect / ability on the card that uses X, and “cards making up this character with the same name as this card” (or with a given “name”) is counted from the character's stack. A3-24 3465's +X Defense uses it.

Damage-zone abilities (65 on Fast / Project / Permanent / Break cards): “このカードがあなたのダメージ置き場にある場合、…” works while the card is in your damage zone — stat changes and skills for the characters it names (e.g. A3-25 3695: your mental-attack dominated characters get Intercept and Mental +1), “≪あなた≫はドロー+1を得る”, and cards that may be used / set from the damage zone like from the hand (a Use button in the damage-zone list). Ones with an extra condition (e.g. “必要ファクターを満たした状態で”) are shown as reminders.
Target qualifiers now count for “all …” effects and abilities: ▼を持たない / ▼を持つ, 精神攻撃力を持つ, ブレイクしている / していない, ネームレベル(でない), パワーが精神力に等しい, パワー0.

title: Battle System, Response phase, Ability System
items: Battle System (rulebook ch.6), the same for faction-check and main-phase attacks: Attack → Guard (guard / no guard) → Response phase → Before battle → Battle → After battle. The steps show in the Battle box.

Response phase: every player may answer with Fast / Project cards or effects, then presses Pass. The battle starts when everyone has passed; any new action (card, effect, damage, stat change …) lets everyone answer again. Solo Test: one Pass.

Ability timing: abilities that trigger when it attacks, when guard is declared, before battle, after battle, when this card is set and when it is dominated appear in the Battle box as “Abilities triggered”; their owner presses Run (choosing a target like an effect) or Skip. The battle waits for them. During battle abilities (“…して判定する”) count only while the character is battling — also those that hit the battle opponent.

Ability System: every non-effect line of every Character / Break / Permanent card (4,533 abilities on 3,108 cards) is read like an effect: trigger, during battle, or always on. Always-on stat changes and skills are applied automatically — on the character itself, or as a Field effect on every character they name (listed in the Field effects box as card abilities). Always-on damage protection (“精神ダメージを受けない”, “ブレイクしていないキャラクターとのバトルによるダメージを受けない” …) is applied too. Other always-on rules are shown on the card and in the Field effects box as reminders.
Effects and abilities with “Xは…に等しい” now use that X (e.g. this character's power).
Card details list each card's abilities with their timing. dist/card_rules_audit.xlsx lists every effect, condition and ability of every card and whether the table does it automatically.

title: Auto-skip phases
items: New option Auto-skip phases with nothing to do (Solo start screen, the control box before the game, and a checkbox in the control box during the game; your own setting, remembered). On your turn it moves on by itself: Faction phase once every ▼ attack has been resolved (or there is none); Power card phase when nothing more can be charged (every character is full, or no cards in hand and the deck allowance is used); Discard phase when your hand is within the limit (the turn ends). A short message shows each skip. A phase you come back to with Undo is not skipped again.

Effects that work on “1 area of your choice” (e.g. A3-24 3500 “2: Discard 1 power card set on each character in 1 area of your choice”): after choosing the effect you first pick the area (any player's Active or Control area, with the number of characters and power cards in each), then pay; each character there loses 1 power card.
Control area (Front and Back): cards are centred, on the same centre line in both rows; the Project / Fast box stays at the right edge.

title: Field effects box
items: Field effects moved from the bar above the table into a small ✦ Field effects N box at the top of the right column, beside the field. It shows only the number of field effects; click it to see each one (what it changes, which characters, how long). − next to an effect ends it; + below the list adds one (stat / cost change, power cards visible, one-time area damage). A request to make power cards visible opens the box on the other player's side with Agree / Decline.
Solo Test start screen: the Deck and Game rule dropdowns are normal size again.

Solo Test: choose whether you go first (no draw on turn 1, as the rulebook says for the first player) or second (you draw on turn 1) — on the start screen, or in the control box until you keep your hand. Conditions like “あなたが先攻でない” follow it.

title: Area damage; refactoring
items: 💥 Area damage (above the table, next to Field effect): deal X damage and / or mental X to every character in a Control area, an Active area, a whole territory, a faction party or the whole game — optionally only characters with an icon, faction, broken / not broken, name, power ≤ / mental ≤. Shield, Resist and the usual damage rules apply to each character. Effects that hit “all” characters (e.g. ≪対戦相手の支配キャラクター全て≫に1ダメージ) already do this automatically.

Refactoring: the 1,900-line play file is split into engine / network / rendering / input files; the Field effect and Area damage dialogs share one target form; the table now applies new events directly instead of replaying the whole game each time (faster in long games); 30 unused style rules and the old hand-size code removed. All requirements are collected in docs/requirements.md.

title: Game rule: hand power cards face up / down; Project / Fast box
items: Game rule chosen before the game starts: power cards set from the hand are Face up (default) or Face down. Solo Test: on the start screen. Play Online: in the control box while deciding the first player and the opening hand — either player can change it until the game starts, and the log shows each change. Face down: the opponent sees the card back; you still see your own card (dimmed, dashed edge). Cards charged from the deck stay face down as before; the “power cards visible” field effect still shows everything.
Project and Fast cards in use now sit in their own Project / Fast box at the right end of the Control area (Front), apart from your characters.

title: Power-card targets, Solo deck / name / End game
items: Effects that target a power card (e.g. A3-24 3500 “1: Discard target ≪1 power card≫”): after choosing the effect, the power cards you can target glow blue — click the one you want (face-down ones too). It goes to its owner's discard pile. If the effect pays from the same character, the targeted card is not used to pay.
Solo Test start screen: choose which of your 10 deck slots to play and type your name.
Solo Test: ■ End game ends the game and goes back to the start screen; ✎ Rename changes your player name during the game (also in Play Online).
Power card phase: left click a picked hand card again (or a card in the Charge window) to un-pick it. Right click now always shows card details.

title: Condition System, Capacity hand limit
items: Condition System: abilities like “if 「魔人“アシュタルテー”」 is under this card, this character gains Infinity and the effect 2: …” (A3-24 3500) now work. 251 conditions on 245 Character / Break cards are read from the card text. While a condition holds, the character gets its skills, stat change and effects (they appear in its effect menu). A ◆ badge on the card shows a condition is met.

228 conditions are checked automatically (card under this one, power = N / = mental, permanent set, named character on the field / in your control area, N dominated characters with an icon, damage pile / deck / hand counts, name-level characters …). The other 23 (e.g. “you satisfy 冥冥冥”) are switched on or off by the player in the character's menu (◆ Condition …). Card details list each card's conditions.
Hand limit = 7 ± Capacity of your dominated characters (e.g. Capacity −1 → 6). The hand panel shows Hand N / limit, and the Discard phase and End turn use it.

title: Attack, Effect System, effect-cost filter, new control column
items: Attack (Main phase only, rulebook p.29): click a dominated character → Attack (with Boost if it has it). The opponent gets a Guard phase (guard or no guard), then Fast cards / effects, then Resolve: battle with the guard, or damage to the player. You can also attack an active character in your own faction area (no guard, straight to battle). One attack at a time; Next / End turn wait until it is resolved. Offensive and Defensive return the attack / guard cost to hand.

Effect System: all 2,128 effects in the card list are sorted into 41 effect types in 11 groups (cost to hand, stat change, damage, discard, bounce, cancel attack, gain skill, draw …). When you use an effect, the table asks for its target and power cards, then does it automatically. Steps it can't do yet are written in the log as “✋ Do by hand”. Effect types show as coloured chips in card details and in the effect menu.
Card List / Deck Builder: new Effect cost filter and sort (a card with several effects matches any of its costs; sorting uses the lowest).
Dominated characters move to Control area (Back); a character you set a Break card on moves to Control area (Front).
Power card phase: only characters whose power is still below their Mental are highlighted.

The control box (phase, Undo / Redo, Next) moved under the Battle box; together they form one fixed-size column on the right. The hand panel shows only your hand, at one fixed card size, under the field. The Guard button no longer runs over the box edge.

Field: the three areas (Active, Control Front, Control Back) always have exactly the same height, and each has its pile on the right — Active ↔ Damage, Front ↔ Deck, Back ↔ Discard. The +1 Normal / +1 Special damage buttons moved next to your name.

title: Paying with chosen power cards, Break rules, Battle box
items: Paying a cost: you choose which power card pays. When playing a card, click a power card to pay with it (click again to take it back); clicking the character pays its top one. Attack / guard / effects open a small window to pick the power cards (the top ones are picked first).
Break cards can be set on any character of a faction party in the Active area, not only the top one.
Icon exception: breaking a character that shares no class icon asks you to confirm, and the log marks it as an icon exception.
Break stacks are shown one card at a time in the order they were set: 1 Character → 2 Break #1 → 3 Break #2 (top).
Clearer highlights: playable hand cards have a thick pastel-yellow border; characters you can click (pay, break, guard, set power) have a running blue border.
New fixed Battle box on the right, between the field and the log: the attack in progress (Guard → Fast / effects → Resolve), or the last battle / damage.

title: Missing skills fixed in the card list
items: Cause: the Skills columns were only filled when the skills stood on a line of their own. When a skill and an effect share one line (e.g. A3-BS2 2239 少女探偵団 "▼ チャージ1 1：…"), the skill was missed.

Card list revised: 393 cards got their skills (Charge 341, Intercept 50, Shield 44, Capacity 37, Synchro 18, Resist 12 and others). They now show up in the Charge / skill filters, templates and the Charge +X limit in play.
Effects after skills on the same line are now read too (126 more effects), so these cards can use their effect in Solo / Online play.

title: Faction check order
items: Faction check goes faction by faction (E.G.O. → Arayashiki → WIZ-DOM → Darklore → Polestar Empire → Eraser) and looks at each faction when it gets there: a ▼ character set later (e.g. by damage) attacks if its faction is still ahead, and does not if its faction was already checked.

title: Targeting system, attack / guard costs, damage
items: Targeting system: every ≪target≫ in the card text (9,177 targets, 1,405 wordings) is read as what × how many × whose × where × conditions. Card details list a card's targets.

Field effects choose a scope: whole game, a player's territory, a specific area (Active area, active characters, Control area, its Front / Back row) or a faction party — plus conditions (class icons, faction, broken, ▼, name, power ≤, mental ≤, in battle). The dialog shows how many characters match now.

Attack / guard costs: 1 power card plus changes — Intercept guards for 1 less; Boost lets the attacker pay up to X extra and the guard must pay the same extra; field effects can raise or lower attack / guard costs.
Card list of all targets: targets_catalog.xlsx.

Damage system: normal damage ≥ Defense discards; mental damage (X) removes power cards from a Control area character (not enough → discarded) or is compared with Mental power for an Active area character; both are checked separately.
Skills: Shield (only battle damage), Resist ? (no battle damage from that faction / class), Initiative (strikes first; no damage back if it wins).
💥 Damage… on any character for effects, Fast / Project cards and abilities; ⚔ Battle with the attacking character for main-phase guards.
Player damage: a named character (“ ”) whose name is already on the field goes to the damage pile.

title: Effects and stat calculation
items: Card effects (text starting with a cost, e.g. 1：… / X：…) are read from the card list: 1,455 cards, up to 6 effects each. Card details list every effect with its cost.

Solo Test / Play Online: click a Control area character to use its effects — and the effects of Permanent cards set on it. The cost is paid from that character's power cards (Cost window). X costs ask for X.

Stat calculation: each character shows its total Attack / Defense (green when changed) and Mental in P x / mental. Its menu shows the summary: base + Permanent cards + Fast / Project / effect changes + field effects = total.

± Stat change… on a character (until end of turn, end of main phase, or until removed) and Field effect: stat change… for every matching character (e.g. all Student icon characters Attack / Defense +2).
Totals are used for domination (Mental), power limits and battles.
Card list copy with new columns: Effect Count, Effect Costs, and Cost / JP / EN for each effect.

title: Faction check: ▼ attacks, Guard phase, Resolve
items: Faction phase: each top active character with ▼ Aggressive attacks you, one at a time (E.G.O. → … → Eraser).
Guard phase: click a Control area character with power cards to guard (pays 1), or choose No guard.
Then use Fast cards or effects, and press Resolve: no guard = damage to you (normal damage), guard = battle (damage ≥ defense discards; mental attacks remove power cards).
You move on to the Main phase after every attack is resolved.

title: Template: picked cards first, pinned counts
items: Templates: cards you have picked move to the top of their list.
The card counts (characters / non-characters / deck, and this step's count) stay pinned at the top of the template window while you scroll.

title: Visible power cards
items: Power cards now show under their character: charged from the hand face up (click to see), charged from the deck face down in your sleeve — face up while the power card field effect is on.

title: Faction party view, Control area order
items: Active area: characters under the top one in a faction slot peek out above it; click one to see it.
Control area: ◀ Move left / Move right ▶ in the card menu, or drag a card onto another card to put it in front of it (also across the front and back rows).

title: Hand size, movable Charge window
items: User Control Panel: hand size Small / Large / Collapse (Collapse hides the hand and keeps the control box).
The Charge and Cost windows can be dragged by their title bars, like the panel.
Floating windows are always drawn above the tab bar.

title: User Control Panel, unlimited re-shuffle
items: Your hand and the control box are merged into the User Control Panel, a pop-up window at the bottom of the screen. Drag it by its title bar, fold it, or send it back to the bottom (⤓).
Opening hand: Re-shuffle hand can be pressed any number of times until you press Keep hand.

title: Deck sleeves, Charge window, Cost window
items: Deck Builder: Sleeve — choose an image for the deck's card back and adjust its size and position to fit the card. Default: the Aquarian Age card back. Sleeves show in Solo Test and Play Online.
Power card phase: picked cards open a Charge window (hand cards face up, deck cards as your sleeve). Click a character to set the next card, one at a time.
Power cards charged from the deck stay hidden (sleeve) even to you.
Paying power cards opens a Cost window showing the paid cards; put them into the Discard pile, Hand, Damage or Deck.

title: Redo, 10 deck slots
items: ↷ Redo next to Undo in the control box.
Deck Builder: 10 deck slots — pick a slot next to the deck name; each slot keeps its own deck.
Export: This deck or All decks (one text file with every deck, or one image per deck). Importing an “All decks” file restores each deck to its slot.

title: Damage types, control box beside the hand, drag rows
items: Two kinds of damage: +1 Normal — a Character from the top of the deck goes to the Active area, any other card to the damage pile; +1 Special — always the damage pile.
The control box (phase, buttons) now sits to the right of your hand.
Drag a card between Control area (Front) and (Back) at any time (the card menu still works on phones).
↶ Undo moved into the control box.

title: Solo Test tab
items: New 6. Solo Test tab: play your Deck Builder deck alone on the same table, with the same phases, power card rules, Undo and card sizes. Every turn is yours. ↻ New game starts again with your current deck.
Play Online moves to tab 7.

title: Play Online: phase window, card sizes, Draw/Charge skills
items: Phase controls moved into a small phase window on the right that you can drag anywhere.
The game log folds into a side tab.
Card size: Small, Middle (fits the board) or Large.
Cards under a Break peek out above it; click one to see it.
Draw phase draws 1 + the Draw ±X of your Control area characters.
Power cards from the deck are limited each turn to the sum of Charge +X in your Control area.
Damage, deck and discard piles are now card-sized and stacked down the right edge of each board.

title: Play Online: table layout, power limit
items: Table order from the middle: Active area → Control area (Front) → Control area (Back). Move your characters between the front and back rows to show which ones you mainly play.
Project and Fast cards are placed in the Control area (Front).
Power card phase: setting power cards that would go over a character's Mental is refused with “Power exceeds Mental”.

title: Play Online: phase-based game
items: Game starts with Decide the first player (coin toss or choose), then each player keeps or re-shuffles the opening hand once.
Turns follow the rulebook: Draw (first player skips turn 1) → Faction → Main → Power card → Discard, with a big [Player] [Phase] banner and one button to move on.
Left click plays a card for the current phase; right click (long press on phones) shows card details.
Main phase: characters go to the Active area slot of their faction (6 slots); Break, Permanent, Project and Fast cards ask for their cost and target.

Power card phase: left click cards in hand or the deck to pick, right click to un-pick, then click a character (top of a faction slot, or any in the Control area). Fully powered characters are dominated automatically.
Power cards stay face down unless both players agree to a field effect.
Undo takes back your last action while the other player hasn't acted.

title: Play Online (virtual table)
items: New 6. Play Online tab: play your Deck Builder deck against a friend on a shared virtual table. Create a room and send the code or invite link.

The table shuffles, deals 7, draws, takes damage (deck top → damage zone) and keeps hands hidden on screen; faction area, dominion area and Project / Fast zone; break, power cards, permanents, paying power cards, turning cards sideways; turn and phase tracker; game log with chat.
Card effects and rule checks are up to the players, like at a real table.
Test on this computer: try it in two browser tabs. Online rooms need a one-time free Firebase setup (steps in the tab).

title: Break-cost return filter, bigger Reset button
items: New ▼ Break-cost return button in the filters (Card List and Deck Builder) to show only those characters.
Reset filters is now a bright red button showing how many filters are on, and a second Reset button sits next to the search box whenever filters are active.

title: Break-cost return characters
items: New optional step Break return after the Draw steps (both templates): characters with “▼ このキャラクターをブレイクする場合、≪そのブレイクカードのコスト≫はオーナーの手札に戻る。”, from every icon and faction, grouped by faction. Add 4–8 cards.
Break return lists characters with your main icon and sub icon first; the rest follow by faction.

title: Break steps use the main factor
items: Full Deck: Break · Charge and Break · Draw only list Break cards from your main factor: main-icon cards first, then sub-icon cards, each section foldable.

title: Template names, split Break steps, foldable sections
items: Templates renamed: Template #1 Full Deck and Template #2 Characters Only.
Full Deck: Break · Charge and Break · Draw are now separate steps, each listing main-icon cards first, then sub-icon cards.
Full Deck: Permanent, Fast and Project list your main factor first, then your sub factor.
Draw steps (both templates) list main-icon characters first, then sub-icon characters.
Every template section can be folded and unfolded; jump links take you to a section.

title: Rarity filter, Template #2 Full Deck
items: Rarity filter and sort in the Stats / Sort row (★ → ★★★★★, U, R, SR, PF, VF, SVF, WR; the ⇅ button sorts rarest first on the 2nd tap).

New Template #2 Full Deck: Main Break cards (search) → Setup → Break cards with Charge / Draw (at least 3 of each recommended; Factor 1 Cost 0 → Factor 1 Cost 1 → Factor 2 Cost 2) → Permanent → Fast → Project (search, main + sub factor, rarest first) → the Template #1 character steps.
Template #2 keeps non-character cards between 28 and 32.
Both templates: ★ Recommended class icons and factions in Setup, taken from the Break cards in your deck; the other choices are listed below.
"Start from an empty deck" moved to the template list.

title: Charge · sub limit
items: Template Character #1: Charge · sub now takes up to 10 cards.

title: Changelog
items: New 5. Changelog tab (this page) listing every update to the site.

title: Foldable filters, sidebar mode, template card targets
items: Filters & Sort button next to the search box, with a badge showing how many filters are active.
Two filter layouts: Inline (fold the filters away; phones start folded) and Sidebar (filters slide in from the left). The site remembers your choice.
Template targets now count cards, not card types: Draw · main 4 cards, Draw · sub 4 cards, Charge · main 12 cards.
Charge steps always show all three icon sections (main + sub, main only, sub only), with jump links at the top.

title: Faction marks, English-first card text
items: Factions in a fixed order: E.G.O. → Arayashiki → WIZ-DOM → Darklore → Polestar Empire → Eraser.
Faction marks from the rulebook on pastel faction colours: in the faction filter, card lists, card details and the template.
Card details show the English card text first, then the Japanese text.
精神力 is now shown as Mental (M in card lists).
Template: Sub Icon None (main icon only); 0–4 copies per card on every step with a quick ×4 button; Draw uses the main icon; Charge lists main + sub icon, then main icon, then sub icon.

title: Template setup redesign
items: Setup has two rows: Main Icon + Sub Icon, then Main Factor + Sub Factor.
Icon pickers show the class icon images.
Sub Icon and Sub Factor can be set to Any.
The Sub Icon list only shows icons found together with the Main Icon, with counts.

title: Database v03, skills, templates
items: Card database updated to AA_cardlist_completed_v03, with English names and English card text.
Skills row: skill checklist (has all / any) and sort by skill value (Charge, Draw, Bind, Capacity, Permanent, Boost, Remove).
Deck Builder: New renamed to Clear.
Deck Builder: Template button with Template Character #1, a step-by-step guide to a 30-character core.

title: English names, class icon images
items: All card names translated to real English; character names romanised from their readings.
Class icons split into Female ♀ / Male ♂ / Other groups, each with its icon image.

title: Class icon filter, faceted filters
items: Class icon (分類アイコン) checklist with two modes: multi-icon in one character, or any checked icon.
Filters update each other instantly: every list only offers values (and counts) that match the other filters.
Code review and refactor.

title: More filters, multi-sort, Rules
items: Faction and Category filters.
Stat filters: Factor, Cost, 精神力, Attack, Defense.
Multi-sort by stats (Small → Large / Large → Small), with a priority order.
Rules tab: a Japanese / English guide to the rulebook and the Partner System.

title: Deck Builder
items: Tabs: Card List, Deck Builder, Discussions (placeholder).
Deck Builder: 50–60 cards, up to 4 copies per name, five categories, Fit to width / Original size, drag and drop.
Export as an image (.jpg) or a text list; import from a text list.
Thai "How to use" guide for the Deck Builder.

title: First release
items: Card List: search by Japanese, English or hiragana; series filter; card details with images from Google Drive.
Starry-sky theme matching the card back, foil card frames and the banner header.
Hosted on Netlify as Aquarian Age Helper.
